identity.checkd_account_binding: server-side persisted consent lookup required; never trust request fields or an unverified token claim

snapshot.current_source: user-scoped Flutter Drift snapshot in local integration tests
snapshot.version: content version is local or test-server supplied; not production authority

registered_read_only_tools.name: get_planning_context
registered_read_only_tools.description: Read the authenticated user's planning snapshot for an inclusive date range.

registered_read_only_tools.name: preview_schedule
registered_read_only_tools.description: Generate a read-only deterministic schedule preview from the authenticated user's server-owned snapshot.

registered_read_only_tools.name: list_tasks
registered_read_only_tools.description: List bounded, incomplete tasks from the authenticated user's planning snapshot.

registered_read_only_tools.name: get_current_plan
registered_read_only_tools.description: Read the authenticated user's current saved plan, when present, from the same scoped snapshot.

registered_read_only_tools.name: check_schedule_feasibility
registered_read_only_tools.description: Check schedule feasibility for the authenticated user's snapshot; heuristic failure is not a proof of impossibility.

registered_read_only_tools.name: generate_adjustment_draft
registered_read_only_tools.description: Generate a non-persistent adjustment draft for the authenticated user's snapshot; no approval or write occurs.

registered_read_only_tools.name: simulate_task_delay
registered_read_only_tools.description: Simulate delaying one of the authenticated user's tasks; does not write changes.

registered_read_only_tools.name: list_plan_risks
registered_read_only_tools.description: Read risks calculated for the authenticated user's planning snapshot.

future_workflows_not_registered.task_create_query_edit: Must be bound to the same verified CheckD principal; current personal stdio task tools are not integrated into this remote service.
future_workflows_not_registered.schedule_proposal_approval_apply: BLOCKED until durable server snapshots, trusted human approval, atomic version compare, allowlisted writes, and authoritative readback exist.
future_workflows_not_registered.background_risk_worker_and_notifications: Local SQLite prototype only; production worker and notification delivery are not integrated.

errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: No valid per-request principal; deny without a fallback user.
errors.AUTH_EXPIRED: Token expired or revoked; production revocation propagation is not yet integrated.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Resource absent or owned by another user; do not reveal which.
errors.SNAPSHOT_STALE: Expected content version differs from the loaded snapshot.
errors.SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE: Snapshot source failed or is unavailable.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Request arguments or snapshot structure are invalid.
errors.NO_PLAN_FOUND: The heuristic did not find a schedule; this is not a proof of mathematical infeasibility.

flutter_local_preview_bridge.device_note: The bridge runs on a developer host; non-desktop Flutter devices require a separately secured tunnel or HTTPS host and are not enabled by this contract.
